knimeNode.name: Spark Rule Engine (HYIM)
knimeNode.shortDescription: Applies IF-THEN rules to a Spark DataFrame using CASE WHEN expressions.

intro.p: Converts user-defined IF-THEN rules into Spark SQL CASE WHEN expressions and applies them to each row of the input Spark DataFrame.
Rules are specified one per line in the format: condition => outcome

ul.li: Logical operators: AND, OR, NOT, XOR
Missing check: $col$ IS MISSING, $col$ IS NOT MISSING
Outcome values: string "text", number 123, TRUE/FALSE, column $col$
Comments: lines starting with // are ignored

tab.name: Rule Editor
tab.option: Left panel: Lists all columns from the input Spark DataFrame with their data types. Double-click a column name to insert it into the rule editor as $column$.
Left panel (bottom): Lists available flow variables. Double-click to insert as $${SvarName}$$.
Center area (top): The main text area where you write rules, one per line. Format: condition => outcome. Lines starting with // are comments.
If checked, rows not matching any rule get a null (MISSING) value. Otherwise, specify a custom default value.
APPEND: Creates a new column with the specified name. REPLACE: Replaces an existing column with the rule result.
The name of the output column (APPEND mode) or column to replace (REPLACE mode).
Right panel: A categorized list of rule syntax elements, operators, and common Spark SQL functions. Double-click to insert into the rule editor.
Center area (bottom): Click Evaluate to validate rules by running them on the Spark cluster. Shows a formatted preview of the result on success.

ports.inPort: Spark DataFrame/RDD to apply rules to.
ports.outPort: Spark DataFrame/RDD with the rule result column added or replaced.
